# ATK Bindings

> > Official site for ATK Bindings - Italian manufacturer of lightweight ski touring, race, and freeride bindings featuring patented technologies like Cam Release and Elastic Response System.

ATK Sports designs and manufactures premium ski mountaineering bindings in Maranello, Italy (Motor Valley), offering specialized collections from ultralight race bindings like the SL WORLD CUP to freeride solutions like the Hy hybrid system. The company holds 60+ patents and serves markets worldwide through their EVO Collection and touring binding lines.

- [ATK Hy™ Free](https://atkbindings.com/en-us/pages/hy): ATK Hy hybrid binding: 675g freeride/touring solution with alpine performance
- [Technology](https://atkbindings.com/en/pages/technology): 60+ patented systems: CAM Release, EVO Brake, Elastic Response technologies

## Featured Bindings

- [FREERAIDER 15 EVO](https://atkbindings.com/en/products/freeraider-15): FREERAIDER 15 EVO: free touring binding with adjustable release & spacer

- [RAIDER 11 EVO](https://atkbindings.com/en-uk/products/raider-11-evo): RAIDER 11 EVO: free touring binding with revolutionary downhill performance
- [CREST 10](https://atkbindings.com/en-us/products/crest-10-24_25): CREST 10 touring binding with Cam Release & Elastic Response System
- [SL WORLD CUP](https://atkbindings.com/en-us/products/sl-world-cup): SL WORLD CUP: lightweight race binding with Monolink technology
